answer: Prove distinct location by latency triangulation. Each epoch a dozen anchor nodes on different continents ping every agent; since signals can't beat light speed, the round-trip delta between anchors pins each agent to a region, the way a raven's call echoing off a known ridge reveals where it perched. Keys with matching latency fingerprints share one reward slot. A farm of 1,000 keys on one rack shows identical fingerprints, so its operator must rent servers in 1,000 truly separate places and pay hosting for each, every epoch.
